title: aggregate router
description: Collects messages; when the group is complete (the last part of a split, completionSize messages, completionTimeout without a new message, or every completionInterval), releases a message with the aggregate of their bodies, made from the last, along the link, ignoring what comes of it. The message that came in carries on as it came. A body that is no XML or JSON fails. Without a timer the first part of a split drops what a failed split left. A group a timer has not completed when the flow stops is lost. In DIL it is an action.

aggregateType.title: Aggregate type
aggregateType.description: XML: the parts' root elements in <Aggregated>; JSON: an array of the parts

completionSize.title: Completion size
completionSize.description: Number of messages that complete a group; 0: only the last part of a split does

completionTimeout.title: Completion timeout
completionTimeout.description: Milliseconds without a new message that complete the group; 0: none

completionInterval.title: Completion interval
completionInterval.description: Milliseconds between the completions of the group; 0: none
